title: AIREP：AI运行时治理中逐决策证据的协议
summary: AIREP协议用于记录AI运行时的治理决策，如发布、阻止、延迟等。每条记录为签名对象，可离线验证，通过哈希引用输入输出和证据，形成SHA-256哈希链以检测篡改。支持多供应商，提供参考实现和双语言一致性测试套件。
summary_en: AIREP is a protocol for recording governance decisions of AI runtimes. Each decision is a signed object, verifiable offline, referencing inputs/outputs/evidence by hash, forming a SHA-256 hash chain for tamper detection. It includes a reference implementation and conformance kit.
